application_crashes: Strata SIGABRT events are recorded earlier; they are not evidence of the host reboot cause.
conclusion: Unclean host restart interrupted the test. CPU/RAM overclock instability, power/PSU or firmware reset, and an unlogged kernel/driver failure remain hypotheses, not established causes. Absence of logged errors does not exclude them.
actions_taken: Read-only diagnosis and saved evidence only; no stress tests, BIOS changes, service changes or process termination.
recommended_next_step: After user approval, repeat controlled tests at CPU stock and RAM JEDEC settings first, adding CPU temperature telemetry. Do not change CPU and RAM overclock independently until a stock baseline is stable.
